description_en: Modifies the configuration information of a store
kebab_example: aliyun cloudesl update-store-config --notification-silent-times from_:960,_to_:1320_,_from_:1170,_to_:1230 --enable-notification true --store-id s-sds12330000 --notification-web-hook https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0. --extra-params example-string --subscribe-contents example-string --api-version 2020-02-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateStoreConfig

parameters.help_en: The silent periods configured by the user during which notification messages are not sent. The value is a JSON list in minutes. Each JSON object represents a silent period time range, where the values are the minute offsets within a day in UTC time. The "from" field specifies the start minute of the silent period, and the "to" field specifies the end minute
parameters.help_zh: 用户配置的静默期，不发通知消息，JSON列表，单位为分钟，每个JSON字段表示一个静默期时间段，里面的值为UTC时间下一天里面的分钟数，from为静默期的起始分钟数，to为结束分钟数
parameters.name: notification_silent_times

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable DingTalk exception message notifications. Set to true to enable or false to disable
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用钉钉异常消息通知，true 启用，false不启用
parameters.name: enable_notification

parameters.help_en: The store ID or a custom store ID defined by the merchant
parameters.help_zh: 门店ID或商家自定义门店ID
parameters.name: store_id

parameters.help_en: The webhook URL for DingTalk messages
parameters.name: notification_web_hook

parameters.help_en: The system extension field. Ignore this parameter
parameters.name: extra_params
